name: Tenderfoot Camp
description_short: Day camp for ages 3 to 6 on Friends' Central's Old Gulph Road Lower School campus in Wynnewood, with daily swim lessons and free swim in an outdoor pool, art, music, maker, nature, yoga and themed weeks in small age based bunks.
refund_policy_summary: Cancel in writing by March 31, 2027 with a $250 fee per camper; no refunds from April 1, 2027, though canceled weeks can become an account credit.
swim_waterfront_notes: Instructional swim every morning and required free swim in the afternoon in the outdoor pool, with at least five certified lifeguards on duty.

sessions.name: Summer 2027 (choose 3 to 7 weeks; no camp July 5)

notes: Three week minimum; weeks need not be consecutive. 2027 full day packages (9 am to 3 pm): 3 weeks $2,604, 4 weeks $3,472, 5 weeks $4,295, 6 weeks $4,980, 7 weeks $5,320. Half day (9 am to 12:15 pm) for 3 year olds only: $1,569 to $3,262. $500 deposit; $100 sibling discount; first time Tenderfoot campers get 10% off. Enrollment opens January 4, 2027. Good Morning Club 7:30 to 8:15 am ($85 a week) and After Camp Experience 3:20 to 5:45 pm ($170 a week). An inter campus shuttle to Trailblazer Camp on City Avenue costs $154 a week round trip; there is no home bus. Tuition assistance is offered only for the Basketball, Reading, and Math Clinic. Campers must be fully toilet trained.
